title: A length converter tool
request:
Add an MCP tool named convert_length that converts a length between "m", "km",
"mi" and "ft". Its arguments are value (number), from and to (units). It answers
{"value": <number>}. An unknown unit is an error. Put the arithmetic in
lib/length.ts as an exported function convertLength(value: number, from: string,
to: string): number that throws an Error for an unknown unit, and write tests for it.
